Esther 4:17n: Now we have sinned before Thee, and Thou hast handed us over to our enemies because we glorified their gods. Thou art righteous, Lord.
Esther 4:17o: Now they are not satisfied with the bitterness of our slavery, but have placed their hands upon the hands of their idols, to abolish the decree of Thy mouth, wipe out Thine inheritance, close the mouth of those who praise Thee, and extinguish the glory of Thy house and Thine altar,
Esther 4:17q: Do not hand over Thy sceptre, Lord, to those who do not exist. Do not let them mock us at our downfall, but turn their plan back upon them, and make an example of the one who began this against us.
Esther 4:17r: Remember, Lord; make Thyself known in the time of our affliction. Give me courage, King of the gods, who dost hold sway over every dominion.
Esther 4:17s: Put well-ordered speech in my mouth before the lion, and turn his heart to hatred of the one who wages war against us, to bring him and those of one mind with him to an end.
Esther 4:17u: Thou hast knowledge of all things, and Thou knowest that I have hated the glory of the lawless and abhor the bed of the uncircumcised and of every foreigner.
Esther 4:17w: Thou knowest my necessity: I abhor the sign of my exalted position upon my head on the days when I appear. I abhor it like a menstrual cloth, and I do not wear it in my days of quiet.
Esther 4:17x: Thy slave woman has not eaten at Haman’s table; I have not honored the king’s drinking feast or drunk wine of libations.
Esther 4:17y: Thy slave woman has had no joy from the day of my change until now except in Thee, Lord, God of Abraham.
Esther 4:17z: God who is mighty over all, hear the voice of those who have lost hope, and rescue us from the hand of evildoers. Rescue me from my fear.”
